model_system: [(BiFeO3)7/(SrTiO3)4]8 multiferroic oxide superlattice on (001)pc-LaAlO3 substrate; additionally 2% Sm-doped BFO in the same superlattice architecture

key_params.observables: out-of-plane polarization maps, in-plane polarization vectors, Pontryagin density, total planar topological charge

headline_claim: 2π-skyrmions have the widest thermal stability window, up to 600 K, and 2% Sm doping enables room-temperature stabilization of 2π-skyrmions.
replication_difficulty: medium - phase-field setup is standard in ferroics, but reproducing the exact thermal phase sequence needs the paper’s temperature-dependent Landau coefficients and boundary conditions.
